notes.title: 1.0.6 - Halloween Contents, Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 1.0.6 release notes.

In this update, we've added some Halloween decorations and also focused on bug fixes and gameplay improvements.

In future updates, we promise to improve the English translation of the game and also to add more supported languages.

❗ macOS minimum system requirements is now version 10.13 instead of 10.12. If needed, please update your operating system.

🐛 1.0.7 Hotfix - Fixed cases where the customer thinks the player hid a card on the private slot when none was hidden.

- Release Notes
    
New Features

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/da92f5b23200c50107db5ff4c694e167c29b28ab.gif

    ✨ Happy Halloween! Decorations have been placed all over Ajik City. You can also select "Dracula" for Hue's appearance.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/149ee28c3cfc2e33a38c017aaf2ad698c66b1341.gif

    ✨ Missed the dialogue? No worries now! We've added a log you can browse to check back what the customer was saying.

Known Issues

    ❗ We're working on cases where the mouse disappears during the game. This may have been fixed by this update, but we're keeping our eyes on this issue.
    
    ❗ We're working on cases where players can get stuck in the flower shop in the challenge mode. This may have been fixed by this update, but we're keeping our eyes on this issue.
    
    ⚠️ Checking on graphic glitches in the street view
    
    ⚠️ Trying to fix cases where the player can fall of the elevator
    
    ⚠️ Working on a case where the bonus extra slot for the auction is not being applied correctly.
    
    ⚠️ Some UI elements in the tutorial are not fully translated.

notes.title: 0.11.7 - Bug Fixes, Steam Cloud Save
notes.notes:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you the 0.11.7 release notes. Please check below for more details.

Steam Cloud Save Files

[strike]Starting today, we will now enable Steam auto-cloud, which syncs save files across devices. New saves will be synced, but already existing save files may not be included. Please refer to  Steam's cloud FAQ for more.
[/strike]

A critical issue regarding steam cloud deleting local save files on Mac computers has been reported so steam cloud is now temporarily deactivated. This problem may likely occur when steam cloud fails to sync on some computers. Other game users on different game platforms have also went through the same problem, but unfortunately no proper solutions have been found to recover the lost files. Please email us at support@hoochoogamestudios.com if you also have this problem. We'll see if there's anything else we can help you with.

notes.title: 0.9.9 - Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you 0.9.9 patch notes.

We are focusing on fixing bugs and improving late game.

We are listening hard to your bug reports and feedbacks, for which we are always grateful. We apologize for not being able to respond to all posts. We will work harder to respond to your posts.

New Features

🎨 More events after day 25.

We heard a lot of feedback that players feel late game as being monotonous. So, we are adding more events during that period. We will continue to improve this part right up until our 1.0 launch.

🎨 More ways to dispose umbrellas.

Another option to dispose umbrellas, instead of forcedly giving it up to AVAC, has been added.

🎨 The '~' key now closes the manual when the manual is open on the table of contents page.

🎨 You can now toggle open and close the reputation status panel with the 'R' key.

Improvements

🐛 Fixed hair / clothes unlock, and bugs in other stores

Fixed an error where new hair and clothes are not unlocked. Fixed Hanja saying only one item being able to disposed when there are many at JunkJunk.

🐛 Fixed some erroneous item data, including Chirplight products slogan.

Chirplights had their slogans wrong despite being a genuine item, making the brand appraisal confusing. This has now been fixed, along with other minor errors with other item designs. Validating all items is currently an ongoing process.

🐛 Fixed "Recommended by Darcy's" reputation

We got a lot of feedback that the "Recommended by Darcy's" reputation does not rise above 30%. After looking into the issue, we decided to remove one part of the requirement for level up.

🐛 Fixed the last slot in the display case not working correctly.

🐛 Fixed an issue where the Auction store was not calculating the commission fee as stated.

🐛 Fixed cases where some brand detail pages had the order of the materials wrong.

🐛 Fixed cases where customers tried to underprice the items for being scribbled on when there is no signature at all.

🐛 Fixed cases where items can be purchased for 0V.

notes.title: 0.7.2 Patch Notes and Development Schedule Update
notes.notes:
0.7.2 Patch Notes

Improvements

❗ An issue where some purchases ending in duplicate items in inventory has been fixed. Cases where presenting one of the duplicate items during curation breaking the game have also been addressed.

🐛 The formula for calculating item sale margin in the display case has been fixed.

🐛 Fixed cases where a choice in a particular event broke the game.

Known Issues

❗ We are investigating cases where number of visiting customers drop too much.

⚠️ Sometimes interactions in street stores freeze the game.

⚠️ Recommended price for a recommended item can be too high.

⚠️ Multiple events in street view get mixed up and potentially freeze the game.

⚠️ The guy who offers to repair the store doesn't show choice buttons and freeze the game.

⚠️ In some unknown case, it becomes impossible to display the item altogether.

⚠️ Some dialogue texts being occluded from view by black bars.

⚠️ NPC lips moving when they are not talking.

Development Schedule Update

Despite our promise to bring you version 1.0 in November, we have failed to meet this deadline. W e apologize sincerely to all of you waiting patiently for a finished product. We are putting every effort and time we have into completeing this game.

We will focus on these parts during December.

Bug Fix

From critical bugs freezing the game to smaller hitches, we apologize sincerely for any inconveinence you encountered while playing the game. We are improving internal QA pipelines, and recently added an in-game bug reporter that helps to track down issues.

Balancing

The overall gameplay difficulty, economy, and customer tactics will be tuned.

Final Polish

We plan to improve game sound, and more importantly make improvmenets to the game ending sequences.

We will put our best effort to finishing this game. If you wish to give general feedback, please tell us through the forums. If you wish to submit a bug report, please use the in-game bug reporter.

Thank you,

Hoochoo Game Studios.

notes.title: Version 6.0: Now on the Main Branch
notes.notes:
Hoochoo Game Studios brings you news on the update 0.6.

Update 0.6, which was available only in beta, is now live!

This update introduces the "Reputation" of your store that you must keep in check. Also, you may "Rent" out items to customers in as a new way to raise profit.

Check out the details about these new mechanisms in our previous post about the 0.6 beta.

- Reputation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/f881ceeac1bd4e7e616d172c7b07d67269c51261.png

- Rental Service
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/976e7543f046a5ecd4d167d4580b7a0067b26860.gif

Message from the developers

First of all, we'd like to thank all the players who have joined us in the beta branch, giving valuable feedback as well as bug reports.

We would also like to apologize sincerely for the players who have encountered critical bugs or grew weary of some repetition in late gameplay.

We are trying to streamline the QA pipeline so that all critical bugs can be addressed ahead of release. We are also working on a bug reporter and debugger so that we can address issues faster and with more accuracy.

We have also added late game mechanics to mitigate the repetitiveness of late game gameplay, and will contine to explore measures to help further fix this issue.

Finally, a lot of player feedback expressed dissapointment in the endings of the game being too short and sudden. The current endings don't include all of our planned content, and will be polished much more. We will strive to deliver satisfactory endings to you in the final release.

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.6.0 Beta Release
notes.notes:
We are launching the 0.6.0 update to the beta branch!

In this update, we introduce the last pieces of the game mechanic, "Reputation" and "Rent". The remaining fifteen days of story and all endings are also included in this update.

Reputation
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/f881ceeac1bd4e7e616d172c7b07d67269c51261.png
The reputation of your store is represented with these three cards. Actions you take during the course of the game will improve or degrade each of these cards, and customers will respond to such change accordingly.

notes.title: 0.6.0 update notice
notes.notes:
We'd like to share news about the coming 0.6.0 and full release!

The upcoming 0.6.0 will be the last major update before the full release. The 0.6.0 update will feature new mechanisms "Reputation" and "Rent". Most importantly, 0.6.0 will feature extended gameplay to day 40 and all endings. After this update, we will focus on final polish of the game rather than adding new mechanisms.

Thanks to the community feedback and support, we've had the chance to understand how you feel about the game and improve the design of both storytelling and gameplay. We are finally ready to show you the endgame!

However, 0.6.0 will initially launch on our beta branch on October 30th. We will provide instructions on how to participate in the beta branch after the update. This major update is so big in volume that our quality assurance efforts was not able to cover the update throughly in time. Knowing that this is a very important update that will represent the final form of the game, we decided to first disclose the content on beta branch until it is stable enough.

Meanwhile, the final release of the game has been postponed to November. We apologize sincerely for keeping you waiting. Even after the roadmap announcement, we decided to add more and more content to improve the game. We'd like to thank everyone for bearing with us patiently. We are doing our best to deliver our game with quality and stability in the final release.

Thank you.

notes.title: 0.5.0 Update
notes.notes:
Version 0.5.0 is finally ready!

With this update, we’re adding eight neighboring stores that will stimulate your purchasing desire and make your store operations more diverse. Visit the stores and invest in yourself with the money you earn at Darcy’s!

For example, if your economic situation gets worse, try the Auction House. From there, you can make a killing with a single item. However, don’t ever try to fool the auctioneer. She always eventually finds out the real value of your items. She can even give you a penalty. To avoid the penalty, it is very important to carefully appraise the items at the start.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/7bff1a3a176bf74ffc136af37ed5d9567705c730.gif

Yes, Ajik City is where ‘Avarice’ is not allowed. But, it doesn’t mean you have to make yourself look boring. There are two shops waiting for Floaties who were born to be fashion-conscious.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/2ff9cab06674d91c60390a04e0d0646d00bfaa99.gif

They say information is a powerful weapon. It’s time to say good-bye to the days you just sit and listen to what customers come to tell you. Visit the new Citizen Discourse Data shop and catch on to what's going on in the city. By this, you can become a manager who's got a quick ear.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/92a4ce0ef209564d515f9854bfb9ed9ac9f91b97.gif

Besides, you can visit other shops to buy flowers, to fix or resell the items you bought, and to buy a house. Or just stop by Jane Kim's jewelry shop to say hello. But, all these stores are closed exactly at the same time as you. So make sure to visit them in the morning.

Last but not least, version 0.5.0 also includes a series of missions that will make your gameplay more challenging. With this, the overall economic system and balancing will continue to improve until the official launch.

The 0.6.0 version, which will be released in late October, will include the stories of the remaining 15 days and several Achievements. Until the official launch, we will keep our best to make a high-quality game. Thank you!

notes.title: 0.5.0 - The Street Stores Update
notes.notes:
This coming September 25th,  will be released in version 0.5.0!

- New Features

    As announced at the time of the 0.4.0 release, nine neighbor stores will be available in the 0.5.0 patch. Visit 9 neighbor stores on your way to work, including a repair shop and a flower shop!

    In addition, the overall economic system has been refined for more challenging gameplay.

    - Quests are given to motivate them to raise money.
    - Improve product prices and card effectiveness with smooth gameplay.

    The economic system will continue to improve until the official launch.

- Version 0.6.0 Preview: Full Story Open & 'Reputation' Cards

    Version 0.6.0 will be the last version to be released before the official launch. With it, we'd like to open the whole story and add our new concept of 'Reputation'. Also, it will reveal all the functional areas except for visual improvements.

    - 'Reputation' Cards?

        Every choice you make affects your overall gameplay. But with just qualitative feedbacks—which used to be our primary way, it's hard for the player to feel the change. And we thought it is hard to be called a good game design when it forces players to experience the change of gameplay with harsh, merciless feedback. Instead, we've decided to choose a more direct and explicit way.

        So, from now on, all of the things that were "appraised" and "recommended" by Darcy's will be tagged with cards called [Appraised by Darcy's] or [Recommended by Darcy's]. The effect of each card will be minimal at the start, but it will get stronger depending on the player's effort. For example, if the player continues to recommend good things, the card [Recommended by Darcy's] will soon work as a strong appeal to the customer.

        We are hoping this will ultimately make players enjoy the feeling of growing their stores.

    The 0.6.0 version was originally planned to be released within September, but sadly it will be delayed from late September to mid-October. It is due to the delay in translation work, and the introduction of the new function we just mentioned. However, we'd like to let you know we will do our best until the end to make a perfect game. Thank you!

notes.title: 0.4.0 - The Avarice Criminal Report Update
notes.notes:
A new major gameplay mechanic has been added - reporting avarice criminals. Players can interact with the world in more ways, and customers will try to buy goods from the player more strategically.

New Feature

✨ Players can now report customers for being too greedy! The Ajik city goes for a wild hunt on Avarice Criminals.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/100157b41575b501f49856f45942459842fbae60.png

✨ Events and haggle situations related to the avarice criminal report system has been added.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/917fd6a504bb77e0fb17784d9608d25794f0ad76.png

✨ Using cards during a conversation is now possible. The card will not be used immediately but put aside in a queue and used as soon as the ongoing conversation is finished.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/be8934d3c49d897e7206a409042a21143c76fe1c.png

✨ Customers looking to buy will now try to negotiate purchase more strategically.

✨ Two more soundtracks have been added for the time spent in the store working.

Improvements

🛠 Frame drops when customers enter the store have been addressed by optimizing customer appearance load and unload.

❗ Font breaking in low resolutions or some aspect ratios has been fixed.

🎨 Added more street events.

🎨 The sky now moves according to the time of day in the store.

🎨 A wake-up scene has been added instead of the previous go-to-sleep scene.

🎨 The elevator will now spawn where the player is, so you don't have to wait for it anymore.

🐛 Some speech bubble texts containing '-' character were not being rendered properly. This has now been fixed.

🐛 Borrowing or paying back loans during a customer event resulted in its being undone as soon as the customer left. This issue has now been resolved.

🐛 Fixed an issue where the jewel inspection tool will not play its animation playing properly.

🐛 Fixed an issue where a pointer click during the use of the jewel inspection tool broke the tool.

🐛 Improved layer order issues between the street characters.

Known Issues

⚠️  Players can enter the store during an ongoing street event in front of the store entrance, possibly breaking the game.

notes.title: About the upcoming 0.4 update
notes.notes:
Hello to all Early Access participants! Check out what is coming in the 0.4 update, about to ship.

New gameplay mechanic - Avarice crime report

As we mentioned in the roadmap announcement post, we felt the need for the player to be able to get engaged more in the story. We looked into ways the player can influence the world.

- We want the fixer to be feared more.

    The talks about the "fixer" may have sparked interest for players, but its prospect was not very threating. The AVAC will now try to rain down the fixer more early in the game.

- The AVAC announces they will use "fixerain" unless the people of the Ajik city behave.

    The AVAC hands out buttons that the people of Ajik city to report each other for their avarice crime. The whole city is challenged to sort out certain number of avarice criminals or suffer the consequences in the form of fixerain doom. Will this policy make the people turn on each other? Or will it make the people unite against AVAC? Maybe, the buttons will just be used to get done with personal feuds.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/d5ec1b53dc2bdf6db5854ab08aff694614fc8a6d.gif

- The policy change will affect the people you meet.

    We have added some new customer behaviors that reflect these changes so that the story can be more dramatically delivered.

Revoked save file compatibility

With this update, previous saves players may have had after day 6 will be disabled. Saves from day 7 or later will not be able to load.

The player feedback from the Early Access so far have got us to realize that big changes - larger than that we previously planned - were needed in order for the game to get better. We have made the difficult decision to revoke some save file compatibility, and instead create room for the gameplay and story to change a lot more.

We sincerely apologize to the players who have been looking forward to continue the game with their latest save from day 25. We have taken great care to make the gameplay better and refreshed the story so that this change would not mean playing the same game over from start again, but be closer to playing a changed, interesting new version of the game. Save file compatibility for saves before day 5 will be maintained, as there are no major changes from the previous version during those play times.

The next update

Although they have not been included with the upcoming 0.4 version, there are plenty more features we are looking to introduce based on player feedback. In version 0.5, players will be able to enter other stores in the street and buy various items.
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/37932204/da9063c7d45fb07de9f2b8daf518f951d8244e60.gif
With the 0.4 update, we will provide more detail regarding the 0.5 update.

A more detailed development roadmap can be found in our previous post.

Thank you.

notes.title: Road Map and Delay of Official Release
notes.notes:
Hi, this is Hoochoo Game Studios.

It's already been 2 weeks since our studio released No Umbrellas Allowed through early access. Over the past 2 weeks, our studio has been able to hear your feedback and find many improvements. Also, we were able to experience a variety of things that you are looking forward to in the game. Among them, there were two things our team members agree to be supplemented.

First of all, we felt the need for a major improvement on the way to and from work. The original commuting route was designed to help you immerse yourself in the world and use it to run the store. But we also felt that the current level of the route is not achieving that goal. So we've decided to add features to eight stores nearby the store and let you visit each of them. Each store will complement the functional limitations of Darcy's or help you operate the store better. For example,

- Auction House: It's a place that you can have another chance to sell the items that seem to have deeper story and value in a higher price.

- Flower shop: Here you can buy flowers that can make a positive difference to your customers.

- Citizen Discourse Data Store: All conversations in the city are recorded in Citizens Discourse Data. We will use various rumors in the data as quests.

Next, we would like to give the player more chance to control the story. In other words, the main character in the game will have a greater impact on the world and we will show it in a more direct way. In the new story, the Association of Victims of Avarice Crimes sets the number of Avarice criminals the citizens have to search every week. If the citizens fail, the Association will drop the Fixerain. In the fear of the Fixerain, you can report some of your customers who seem greedy. However, it is not easy to press the Report Button without a hitch. This is because not only the reported but also all citizens will begin to get wary of you from the moment you are announced to the whole city as an excellent reporter.

The Early Access period of No Umbrellas Allowed will be a little longer to include these two new functions in the game. However, we changed our plan to open the story of the 26-40th day during the Early Access period, which we promised to open with an official release. Our schedule is as below, and as always, we are going to keep distributing the updated version including bug fixes. Thank you!
